## Aktif KPI ayrıntıları

### KPI-001 — Personel Devir Oranı / Employee Turnover Rate / Текучесть кадров

- **Formül:** Separations in period / average headcount in period x 100
- **Pay:** Employment spells ending in period, excluding internal transfers (new in-scope employment within 7 days)
- **Payda:** Mean distinct-person headcount at period start and each month end
- **Amaç:** Workforce stability; separations are also reported by termination category
- **Dahil:** Voluntary, employer-initiated, contract/project end, retirement, death, other, unknown
- **Hariç:** Internal transfers between in-scope entities
- **Veri kaynakları:** employment_relationships · **Veri sahibi:** HR_DIRECTOR
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 35 / 45 / 60 (yıllıklaştırılmış değere uygulanır)
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'annualize': True}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-002 — Personel Devamlılık Oranı / Retention Rate / Коэффициент удержания

- **Formül:** Persons employed in scope at period start and still employed in scope at period end / persons at start x 100
- **Pay:** Start population still employed at period end
- **Payda:** Distinct persons employed at period start
- **Amaç:** Workforce stability. Judged only on >= 12-month windows (colour from 360 days; shorter windows show the value without colour, status_reason short_window). Never annualised: retention does not scale linearly (docs/hr/data/WP-5 section 3.6)
- **Dahil:** All records in scope and period
- **Hariç:** None
- **Veri kaynakları:** employment_relationships · **Veri sahibi:** HR_DIRECTOR
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 75 / 65 / 55
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'threshold_min_days': 360}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-003 — Devamsızlık Oranı / Absenteeism Rate / Уровень абсентеизма

- **Formül:** Absence hours of included types / planned working hours x 100
- **Pay:** Leave hours prorated to period for types in parameter absence_types
- **Payda:** Planned hours on approved timesheets
- **Amaç:** Track absenteeism rate
- **Dahil:** Unexcused absence, sick-note days (raporlu), work-injury / occupational-disease rest (work_injury - included explicitly pending product-owner decision PO-1), annual leave, unpaid leave, other leave
- **Hariç:** Public holidays (not working days); parental/maternity and related protected leave (decision D-6)
- **Veri kaynakları:** leave_records, timesheets · **Veri sahibi:** HR_MANAGER
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 7 / 9 / 11
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'absence_types': ['unexcused', 'sick', 'work_injury', 'annual', 'unpaid', 'other'], 'excluded_types': ['public_holiday', 'parental']}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-004 — İş Gücü Kapasite Kullanımı / Workforce Capacity Utilisation / Использование мощности персонала

- **Formül:** Productive (work-package booked) hours / planned available hours x 100
- **Pay:** Productive hours on timesheets
- **Payda:** Planned hours on the same timesheet rows
- **Amaç:** Track workforce capacity utilisation
- **Dahil:** Only timesheet rows where productive hours were recorded
- **Hariç:** Rows with unknown productive time
- **Veri kaynakları:** timesheets · **Veri sahibi:** OPERATIONS_DIRECTOR
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 85 / 80 / 70
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'min_coverage': 0.5}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-005 — İş Gücü Verimlilik Endeksi / Labour Productivity Index / Индекс производительности труда

- **Formül:** Standard hours earned by quality-accepted output / actual labour hours for that output x 100
- **Pay:** Sum(accepted quantity x standard hours per unit)
- **Payda:** Labour hours on outputs having a standard
- **Amaç:** Track labour productivity index
- **Dahil:** Work types with a valid production standard and an inspection result
- **Hariç:** Outputs without standard or without accepted quantity (counted in lineage)
- **Veri kaynakları:** work_outputs, production_standards, quality inspections · **Veri sahibi:** OPERATIONS_DIRECTOR
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 100 / 90 / 80
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-014A — Kayıp Günlü Kaza Sıklık Oranı (LTIFR) / Lost Time Injury Frequency Rate / LTIFR

- **Formül:** (Lost-time injuries + fatalities) / hours worked x 1,000,000
- **Pay:** LTI + fatality events
- **Payda:** Hours worked (timesheets)
- **Amaç:** Lost-time injury frequency. Colour only when hours worked in the window reach the minimum exposure (formula parameter threshold_min_exposure_hours); below it the value and event counts are shown without colour (status_reason low_exposure) - small scopes are never coloured, judge them at company/tenant level. Any fatality in scope surfaces an alert independent of the rate. The thresholds count as active only once KPI-043 (near-miss reporting rate) is active (HR Director section 3.3 rule 2; docs/hr/hse/WP-2). Minimum exposure: 1,000,000 h.
- **Dahil:** All records in scope and period
- **Hariç:** None
- **Veri kaynakları:** safety_events, timesheets · **Veri sahibi:** HSE_SPECIALIST
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 1.5 / 3.0 / 5.0
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'multiplier': 1000000, 'threshold_min_exposure_hours': 1000000}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-014B — Toplam Kaydedilebilir Olay Oranı (TRIR) / Total Recordable Incident Rate / TRIR

- **Formül:** Recordable injuries (fatality, LTI, restricted work, medical treatment) / hours worked x 200,000
- **Pay:** Recordable events

Colour only when hours worked in the window reach the minimum exposure (formula parameter threshold_min_exposure_hours); below it the value and event counts are shown without colour (status_reason low_exposure) - small scopes are never coloured, judge them at company/tenant level. Any fatality in scope surfaces an alert independent of the rate. The thresholds count as active only once KPI-043 (near-miss reporting rate) is active (HR Director section 3.3 rule 2; docs/hr/hse/WP-2). Minimum exposure: 500,000 h (HR Director WP-2 Q2).
- **Dahil:** All records in scope and period
- **Hariç:** None
- **Veri kaynakları:** safety_events, timesheets · **Veri sahibi:** HSE_SPECIALIST
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 1.0 / 2.0 / 3.5
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'multiplier': 200000, 'threshold_min_exposure_hours': 500000}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-020 — Gönüllü Devir Oranı / Voluntary Turnover Rate / Добровольная текучесть

- **Formül:** Voluntary separations in period / average headcount in period x 100
- **Pay:** Employment spells ending in period with termination category 'voluntary', excluding internal transfers (new in-scope employment within 7 days)
- **Payda:** Mean distinct-person headcount at period start and each month end (same as KPI-001)
- **Amaç:** Separations the organisation can influence through retention measures
- **Dahil:** Termination category 'voluntary' only
- **Hariç:** Internal transfers; separations with no recorded reason are NOT assumed voluntary (lowers quality score)
- **Veri kaynakları:** employment_relationships · **Veri sahibi:** HR_DIRECTOR
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 12 / 18 / 25 (yıllıklaştırılmış değere uygulanır)
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'annualize': True, 'include_categories': ['voluntary']}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-023 — Ortalama Kıdem / Average Tenure / Средний стаж

- **Formül:** Mean tenure (years) of persons active in scope at period end
- **Pay:** Sum over active persons of (period end - start of current spell) in days / 365.25
- **Payda:** Distinct persons active in scope at period end
- **Amaç:** Track average tenure
- **Dahil:** Current spell only; concurrent spells -> the longest-running one
- **Hariç:** Earlier (ended) spells of re-hired persons are not added
- **Veri kaynakları:** employment_relationships · **Veri sahibi:** HR_MANAGER
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group

### KPI-055 — Yıllık İzin Kullanım Oranı / Annual Leave Utilisation / Использование ежегодного отпуска

- **Formül:** Annual-leave days taken / statutory entitlement days (4857 md.53, prorated to the period) x 100
- **Pay:** Annual-leave days taken in the period (hours / hours_per_day)
- **Payda:** Statutory entitlement of persons active at period end with >= 1 year tenure, prorated to period length
- **Amaç:** Sustainable, humane leave practice: leave is taken, not accumulated (decision D-7). Group level only
- **Dahil:** Persons with >= 1 year of service with the current employer (all spells, 4857 md.54)
- **Hariç:** Persons with < 1 year of service
- **Veri kaynakları:** leave_records, employment_relationships, people · **Veri sahibi:** HR_DIRECTOR
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 90 / 75 / 60
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'hours_per_day': 9, 'threshold_min_days': 360}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE

### KPI-056 — Yıllık İzin Kullanmayan Çalışan Oranı / Employees Without Annual Leave / Доля сотрудников без отпуска

- **Formül:** Eligible persons with no annual leave taken in the period / eligible persons x 100
- **Pay:** Eligible persons with zero annual-leave days in the period
- **Payda:** Persons active at period end with >= 1 year tenure
- **Amaç:** Early warning for workload / burnout at team level (decision D-7); never used to rank individuals
- **Dahil:** Persons whose one-year date is on/before the period start
- **Hariç:** Persons with < 1 year of service at period start; persons on long sick / parental / unpaid / work-injury absence (> half of the window; reported as a count - an injured person is not 'not taking leave', WP-1 example 3, ADR-019)
- **Veri kaynakları:** leave_records, employment_relationships · **Veri sahibi:** HR_DIRECTOR
- **Sıklık / kapsam:** monthly · tenant, legal_entity, project, occupation_group
- **Eşikler (hedef/uyarı/kritik):** 5 / 10 / 15
- **Parametreler (v1):** `{'hours_per_day': 9, 'threshold_min_days': 360, 'long_absence_types': ['sick', 'parental', 'unpaid', 'work_injury']}`
- **Eksik veri:** insufficient_data when source rows absent; not_computable when denominator = 0; suppressed when population < HRSWI_MIN_GROUP_SIZE
